sources.title: Omada SDN Controller User Guide - Manage Omada Managed Devices and Sites
Omada SDN Controller User Guide - Configure and Monitor Omada Managed Devices

state_machine.failure_rule: Any timeout, credential failure, controller reachability failure, wrong-site ownership, Managed by Others, or unexpected terminal state remains NOT_PASS.

site_binding.rule: Adopt the device into the intended site; site context is part of desired state and must be explicit.
site_binding.move_warning: Moving a managed switch to another site can replace prior-site configuration with new-site configuration and clear traffic history.

force_provision.effect: Synchronize controller configuration to the device.
force_provision.expected_transient: Device loses connection temporarily and is adopted again to obtain controller configuration.

remember_device.effect: Controller can automatically adopt the remembered device after reset/power-on if it can find the device.

credential_and_ownership_gates: Do not attempt credential mutation as a discovery shortcut.
Managed by Others must be treated as an ownership conflict, not silently overridden.
Wrong or unknown device credentials block adoption and require explicit operator remediation.

rollback.rule: Before ownership/site/provisioning changes, record prior controller/site/management state. If adoption or provisioning fails, stop additional writes and restore/rebind only through an explicitly authorized recovery path.
